reviews.review: I really appreciate the art style, tone, and story and it's nice to try a game in the "souls" genre with some shooting, I only just found it a bit too difficult for me. Would recommend for anyone that is up for the challenge.

This game is definitely not easy, so yay for you souls fans and it also features a fairly good firearm mechanic. Some of the animations are a little choppy and melee doesn't seem that great if I'm being honest, the character creator could also use some tweaking but otherwise I'm definitely enjoying this sci-fi soulslike.

Amazing game, the story was very interesting. The atmosphere was really scary and unsettling. The controls are very fluid and perfect for mouse and keyboard play. The cyphers really change your whole playstyle and every armor upgrade was something, i was looking forward too. Combat is great, many different enemy types and the bosses and secret bosses very quite challenging.

Honestly, if you aren't a fan of Soul's like games, or Soul's in general, I guarantee you will find this game terrible. 
If you're a fan, you will find it tedious and very unbalanced at times, clunky and full of bugs, but it keeps you coming back for more. it's not a bad game I'd say, just a game that feels clunky, and probably needed another year of development before being released. 

Game-play is just like any other Soul's clone, but adding in guns. Similar level up system, basic character creation, random loot, harsh difficulty, have to get your exp back, etc. After a couple hours, you start to figure out how to build your character, and what to pump your exp into. There is a lot of nice loot, and the environments aren't bad looking. Boss fights are pretty much all the same, mostly just kiting around enemies, waiting for them to leave themselves open, and pumping them full of bullets, rinse and repeat. 

It has a certain charm about it, just a shame it wasn't more polished, cause it could have been something quite special without all the bugs, bad enemy placement, and terrible animations. It's a game I'll play to the end, just to see if it somehow gets a lot better. But for $43 (AUD) The game is definitely not worth that amount of money, so I can't recommend it. Especially since the game is several months past release, and loads of patches later, it's still a buggy mess.

Love  this game. Got really addicted to it. BUT this game has a lot of bugs for exempel: often if you one shot the enemies they will respawn after 4-6 sec. sometimes they do this 5-6 times in the row. another ex. is sometimes "add ons/ do not work at all  AND you cant combine them. Now the most important bug of all: often enemies are really dumb, they just stand and look at you and do nothing.
Overall the game is great. One thing that i wish that they added is that when you find all those green statues that they would put them in the correct order in your inventory so that the player can understand the full story and not just guess.

This game really marries the rewarding mastery of tough-but-fair 3rd person shooters with the Souls-ian approach to building awareness of a beautiful, crumbling environment, interpreting and working around enemy behavior, and esoteric art & story design. I just beat it and started a new playthrough as The Cursed One.

I appreciate in particular the enemy/encounter design. Each new fight is a mean little puzzle, and getting to each next checkpoint/obelisk really felt like a legitimate accomplishment rather than a slog. Every time I thought a particular fight was unfair, the issue was that I was trying the same initial approach over and over again. Thinking for a bit, then switching up tactics (and even weapons) was almost always the path through. That's not to say there aren't tough fights (boy, are there)!

Let's just summarize the experience for anyone looking into buying this game to fill into that "dark souls" void, this is similar but not in a very balanced way or was it ever been put into thought for most parts where they wanted to cheese players into thinking this is actually a difficult game. 

There's a lot going with the storyline and some weapons actually looks interesting but the guns just don't give you that oomph when you shoot and kill enemies. This clearly puts a dampening on the entertainment factor. Like I mean, why would you play a game with guns when your guns aren't even fun at all. bummer.

Verdict: TRY ONLY IF YOU REALLY FIND NO OTHER EXCUSES OF A SOULS ALTERNATIVE, this game is just way too expensive to begin with.
